modules.title: 启发式评估如何依据原则发现体验缺陷
一次启发式评估怎样从问题走到复查

items.title: 先执行一个具体任务
items.text: 评估者进入设置页，修改昵称并点击保存。按钮没有变化，页面也不显示成功或失败；用户可能不知道是否点中、是否仍在处理，以及能不能再次操作。这比“页面看着别扭”更容易讨论。

items.title: 把观察、原则和建议写进同一条记录
items.text: 记录位置为“设置页昵称表单”，步骤为“修改昵称后点击保存”，原则为“系统状态可见”，影响是“可能重复提交”。建议点击后显示“保存中”并暂时禁用按钮，结束后显示成功或失败；严重程度依据发生频率、影响和恢复难度判断。原则用于解释事实，不替代事实。

items.title: 修复后重走同一路径
items.text: 再次修改昵称并保存，确认等待状态立即可见、重复提交被阻止、最终结果清楚。通过复查只能说明这个已知问题得到改善；术语理解和真实环境下的行为仍要让目标用户验证。

modules.title: 专家走查不能完全替代真实用户
modules.text: 启发式评估是基于原则的专业判断，不是客观测量，也不能让评估者变成真实用户。它适合较早发现可能的问题；用户是否理解术语、是否能在真实压力和背景下完成任务，仍要用目标用户测试。

lessonPractice.title: 评估者在设置页点击“保存昵称”后看不到任何变化。哪条问题记录最方便团队修复并在之后复查？

options.label: 写清昵称表单的位置、修改后点击保存的步骤、系统状态不可见原则、用户影响，以及修复后要重走的路径
options.feedback: 对。事实、原则、影响和复查路径都明确，团队可以复现问题，也能判断修复是否有效。

options.label: 只记录“这个页面感觉不高级，建议整体重新设计”，不写位置和操作步骤
options.feedback: 不对。主观评价无法定位或复现问题，也不能判断改动后是否真的改善。

options.label: 直接要求把按钮改成绿色，不说明用户遇到了什么问题，也不重新执行保存任务
options.feedback: 不对。先写清观察和影响，再提出对应建议；只改样式不能证明状态反馈问题得到解决。

en.title: An evaluator clicks Save Nickname in Settings and sees no change. Which issue record best supports a fix and later recheck?

options.label: Record the nickname form location, edit-and-save steps, visibility heuristic, user impact, and the path to repeat after the fix
options.feedback: Correct. The observation, principle, impact, and recheck path make the issue reproducible and the fix verifiable.

options.label: Write only that the page feels unpolished and should be redesigned, without a location or task steps
options.feedback: Incorrect. A subjective reaction cannot be reproduced or used to verify that the change improved the task.

options.label: Ask for a green button without describing the user problem or repeating the save task afterward
options.feedback: Incorrect. The observation and impact must come before a recommendation; a color change does not prove status feedback works.

lessonAgentPrompt.title: 你可以这样告诉 AI Agent
lessonAgentPrompt.text: 请用尼尔森十大可用性原则走查设置页。先按“修改昵称并保存”的真实任务操作，再按问题位置、复现步骤、对应原则、用户影响、严重程度和建议记录发现。修复后重走同一路径，确认按钮会显示保存中、禁止重复提交，并明确显示成功或失败；仍需真实用户验证的地方单独列出。

en.title: You can say this to an AI Agent
en.text: Evaluate the Settings page with Nielsen's 10 usability heuristics. Perform the real task 'edit nickname and save'; record each issue with location, reproduction steps, heuristic, user impact, severity, and recommendation. After fixes, repeat the path and verify an immediate saving state, duplicate-submit prevention, and a clear success or failure result. List what still requires real-user testing.

learning.assumes: You have browsed or designed web pages and encountered frustrating lack of feedback or accidental mistakes.
learning.outcome: You can record a problem's location, steps, heuristic, and user impact, then repeat the same task after the fix.

modules.title: How heuristic evaluation spots UI defects against principles
How one heuristic evaluation moves from issue to recheck

items.title: Start with a concrete task
items.text: The evaluator opens Settings, edits a nickname, and clicks Save. The button does not change and the page shows no success or failure result. The user cannot tell whether the click worked, processing continues, or another action is safe.

items.title: Record the observation, heuristic, and recommendation together
items.text: Record the nickname form, edit-and-save steps, visibility heuristic, and duplicate-submission risk. Recommend a Saving state, temporary button disablement, and a clear result; judge severity from frequency, impact, and recovery difficulty. The heuristic explains the fact rather than replacing it.

items.title: Repeat the same path after the fix
items.text: Edit and save again, confirming visible progress, duplicate-submit prevention, and a clear result. Passing this recheck only shows that the known issue improved; comprehension and real-context behavior still require target-user testing.

modules.title: Expert inspection is not user testing
modules.text: Heuristic evaluation is principle-based expert judgment, not an objective measurement or a substitute for real users. It can reveal likely issues early, while comprehension and behavior in real contexts still require target-user testing.

distinctions.label: A/B Testing
distinctions.text: {c:heuristic-evaluation} is an expert inspection method to catch design flaws against principles; {c:ab-test} randomly splits live users between variants to measure statistically valid behavioral outcomes.

distinctions.label: Acceptance Criteria
distinctions.text: {c:heuristic-evaluation} checks human factors and interaction usability; {c:acceptance-criteria} verifies whether business logic satisfies the specific product scope requirements.
